scope: Proposition 5.4 (Properties of the flow) of the manuscript “A Modulus Proof of Cannon’s Conjecture” (preprints/A-Modulus-Proof-of-Cannons-Conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 246 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 650697e8e95aa8cb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 24. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The construction gives a fixed D and a tree with generation-n centers Hrk0+Dn-separated and descendant displacement (5.19). Its nonempty value intervals are nested, its probabilities satisfy (5.21) and (5.22), and infinitely many levels have good mass at least 1/2. Every node has a fixed expansion. Each good node has a pattern from a finite list of ordered target-ball pairs. For that expansion, each target ball contains a path with endpoint variation at least κ∆i, their whole-ball range intervals have distance at least ∆i/4, and the balls lie in the images of the respective outer balls of radius c0θrk0+Dn.
